thread:
emma: Hi all, first day! Monitor arrived but the power cable is frayed, keyboard is ISO layout (I need ANSI), and the USB-C ethernet dongle wasn't in the box. Also trying to join Redwood-Staff at home gives a dialog: 'certificate not trusted'. Who do I ping for parts and wifi cert help?

carlos_it: Welcome @emma! Sorry about the kit. I'll file a ticket for parts. Quick Q: what's the monitor model and your shipping address? For the cert error, the usual fix is MDM enrollment which pushes our root cert and wifi profile. Try guest Wi-Fi -> https://onboard.redwood.example.com and run the installer.

it-bot: Ticket created: IT-5342. Assigned to carlos_it. ETA response: 1 business hour.

emma: Monitor is ASUS ProArt PA278QV, sent address in DM. Tried onboarding link in incognito and it fails with 'Certificate error: CA not recognized' screenshot DM'd.

carlos_it: Got the screenshot. If onboarding fails we'll push a temporary cert or whitelist your MAC for the day. Also ordering: 1x IEC power cable replacement, 1x US ANSI keyboard, 1x USB-C -> Ethernet dongle. Facilities will ship.

laura_fac: Hi @emma, facilities can ship all three via overnight courier. Need confirmation if someone can sign or if we should leave at the door. Tracking can be provided.

emma: Signature OK. Thanks Laura.

carlos_it: While parts are en route, two quick workarounds: 1) tether phone as hotspot to get online for the onboarding flow; 2) if you have any ad/tracker blockers disable them for the onboarding site (they can block the SSO redirect).

leah: Welcome @emma! If you swing by reception, I can hand you a loaner keyboard until the ANSI arrives.

jamie: I have a spare USB-C ethernet dongle in SF office, can drop at reception today.

emma: Tried phone hotspot -> onboarding still errors with same cert dialog. DM'd an additional screenshot of the cert chain.

carlos_it: Thanks. Looks like your device isn't honoring the corporate root. I'll push a one-off cert via MDM once we enroll the device; for that we need you to run the installer (we can remote assist). If you don't want MDM yet, there's a temporary whitelist option but that needs security approval and is slower.

it-bot: IT-5342 status: Open -> Parts requested; Subtask IT-5343 created for MDM enrollment verification.

laura_fac: Shipment created: FedEx 612345678901. ETA next business day.

carlos_it: Scheduling a short remote session in 15 to attempt enrollment and push the cert. Will DM the session link.

emma: Remote session done, MDM installer completed, rebooted. Confirming Redwood-Staff now connects without cert warnings at home. Thanks!

it-bot: IT-5343 status: Resolved (MDM enrolled, root cert applied). IT-5342 status: In progress -> Parts shipped (tracking attached).

emma: Picked up loaner dongle from reception and the keyboard arrived next day. Everything working now, huge thanks to Carlos, Laura, and the team! :tada:
